Read-only diagnosis of 13 failed CI jobs (F assigned cluster)

Actual checked sources were synthetic merge commits with parent c40d4acae1ce58b597267255026d9356565828fd: PR15 8280a4aa6e028af0dd74d2f987ce6fc6e498b877; PR18 2a8cc6bb6776f74886c2bdb88dbbdb76c93a9225; PR19 674146c9053dc61b9db08bd88d16a76f7cdf51eb; PR29 51bbc932c0efe18c2ab96b56251f1d2ab1a8b78b. Use merge-commit-identities.json for full independently verified parents/tree IDs; run head_sha alone identifies the PR head rather than actual checkout.

Performance on PR15/18/19: 9 failed, 96 passed, 6 skipped per complete log. All nine failures are tests/performance/test_runtime_hot_paths.py and stop at runtime fixture creation before benchmark operations. ControlPlaneService -> DatasetCatalogGraph -> catalog knowledge Store identifies absent production_data/datasets_full_phase3full_20260327_183054/dataset_catalog.duckdb and raises catalog_fetch_source_unreadable. Missing-input/profile boundary, not an observed estimator or timing failure. C/runtime fixture and catalog admission owner should resolve without weakening byte identity. Full production input remains local for G.

Frontend quality on the same PRs: typecheck, lint, format and frontend architecture steps succeeded. Accessibility unit suite passes 87 files/161 tests, then Playwright webServer startup fails through the same runtime fixture/catalog trace. No browser accessibility PASS. CI actually installed frozen pnpm dependencies and Node22.23.3; local unprovisioned Node24 diagnostics are not this cause.

Frontend contract drift on the same PRs: actual generated OpenAPI differs from schemas/runtime_api_v1.openapi.json in the confidence-ledger-risk-spend example. Existing bound_dependency_count 1489->1490, dependency/projection/replay/worker receipt hashes change; frozen semantic projection hash and issue_codes[] remain equal. Dynamic DependencyTracker binds actual file bytes, absent paths, directory listings and loaded repository modules. Complete 1490-entry worker binding map is absent from job diff, so zero intersection/introduction attribution is unavailable. C/runtime OpenAPI owner should obtain that receipt and exact-source deterministic regeneration. Subsequent client-freshness, contract-fixture and build steps were skipped.

Frontend unit coverage on the same PRs: each run reports 2 failed/1926 passed/2 skipped (1930), 2 failed/410 passed/1 skipped files (413). The complete two failures are (1) locale leaf census 2907/2907 vs frozen 2879/2879; immutable PR15 merge en/uk JSON full recursion independently confirms 2907 each, and (2) Atlas native CAS corruption negative test still returns exit1, ok:false, atlas_evidence_persistence_failed, ArtifactIntegrityError/Blob sha256 mismatch, but consumer expects /integrity verification failed/. The latter is error-message ABI disagreement; corruption was rejected. Frontend i18n and evidence/Core/CAS owners, with guard strength preserved. No full Vitest local replay was performed.

PR29 Test economics: this CI label reports suite costs and directory health, not ECO/FRY statistical methods. All three runtime-http/performance/integration JUnit artifacts are absent; --allow-missing reports 0/3 and zero tests, not PASS. Actual failing step is directory-health ratchet. Downloaded artifact11352910341 ZIP SHA25628917e793b36ca1f487c91862da8913e5995771d693dbd9ee8303b71a711b6b4 contains complete JSON: one regression, high-volume documentation98.35 vs baseline100; 179/182 directories documented. Complete missing subset: docs/plans/active/agent-packages (239 tracked files), docs/superpowers/journals/acquisition-movement (20), tests/unit/remediation (87). 0 contract errors/0 closure findings. Render test-ratchet summary skipped. Coordinate substantive docs with owners; do not lower baseline.

No F estimator or scalar dtype regression is observed in these deciding traces, but no full F regression exclusion is claimed. No inherited P41: exact c40 full-gate replay and complete zero-intersection input denominator have not been obtained. Shared symptoms and identical selected direct canonical blobs do not establish inheritance. 48 source records cover only 12 selected paths across four merges, not each full gate denominator.

Evidence: summary.json includes all 13 deciding job URLs, checked source/tree identities, full-log SHA256/byte sizes, complete counts/node IDs, canonical source indexes, artifact hashes and owner boundaries. All job-*.complete.txt files contain complete connector-decoded logs. Failed gh signed-download transport outputs were redacted and explicitly excluded as deciding evidence. No source writes, Git receipt append, workflow rerun, environment install or changes to frozen source worktrees.
